Product Announcement: L-Series with LED Notification Appliances
October 2023
Bulletin M23.2SS
System Sensor is pleased to announce the next generation of L-Series audible
visible notification appliances with the availability of L-Series with LED indoor
strobes and horn strobes. New LED lighting technology offers an average of 40%
lower current draw compared to older xenon bulbs across a full candela range.
This improves design flexibility for notification appliance circuits (NACs) while also
reducing power supply requirements allowing for simpler and lower cost
installations.
In addition, the System Sensor L-Series with LED notification appliances offer a
new diagnostic test point feature that allows you to measure device voltage with a
digital voltage meter (DVM) without removing the appliance from the wall or

you to measure device voltage with a
digital voltage meter (DVM) without removing the appliance from the wall or
ceiling. The DVM test points are discreetly located on the face of the notification
appliance and enable faster troubleshooting and end of line (EOL) voltage
checks while greatly reducing the risk of misplacing or damaging appliances
during troubleshooting.
L-Series with LED Technical and Design Features:
• 40% lower current draw (on average) reduces power supplies and allows more devices per NAC
• DVM test points eliminate the need to remove appliance from wall or ceiling to measure voltage
• Unmatched application versatility with:
o Wall and ceiling-mount models
o Standard and compact sizes for wall applications
o Red or white color options
o Common LED lenses
• Compatibility with legacy System Sensor SpectrAlert, SpectrAlert Advance and L-Series notification

Common LED lenses
• Compatibility with legacy System Sensor SpectrAlert, SpectrAlert Advance and L-Series notification
appliances for retrofit applications
• Common L-Series design aesthetic for continuity with existing L-Series installations
• Dual-listed with both UL and ULC certifications
Additional L-Series appliances including indoor speaker strobes and chime strobes as well as outdoor strobes, horn
strobes and speaker strobes will convert to the new L-Series with LED platform in early 2024. Look for future launch
announcements for the availability of these additional L-Series with LED devices coming soon.
The L-Series with LED indoor strobes and horn strobes are available to order now! Please contact your Customer
Service Representative at 1-800-736-7672 or fire.custserv.us@honeywell.com for ordering and pricing information or

FAQs (Continued) 32
Why isn’t there a 15/75cd Strobe setting?
• Prior to 2005 the 15/75cd rating was relevant since the NFPA 72 and ADAAG had different
requirements
ADAAG referenced ANSI/UL 1638 which only considers strobe performance on axis
NFPA referenced ANSI/UL 1971 which considered performance at various angles. A 15/75cd
device is equivalent to a 15cd device since it only provides 6cd at 60-degrees of access
As of 2010 the Department of Justice (DOJ) published the 2010 ADA requirements, which
harmonized the requirement with the 2002 edition of NFPA 72, thus the 15/75cd is no
longer valid. The 15cd strobe is the standard setting for typical small spaces like hallways.
Can I use an L-Series wall device on the ceiling like I did for the
SpectrAlert Advance?
No, the L-Series wall strobe has been redesigned to provide the lowest profile possible
with the Xenon bulb
